request: I want to add an owner to my Safe. build me the template and its report

title.zh-TW: 新增 Safe 的簽署人

summary.en: The Safe calls its own `addOwnerWithThreshold`, adding the signer you pick from your address book and setting the threshold to the number you type. It needs no earlier step. A transaction that adds anyone else, changes another setting or moves an asset gets MISMATCH.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫自己的 `addOwnerWithThreshold`，加入你從地址簿選的簽署人，並把門檻設成你填的數字。不需要先做別的步驟。加了別人、改了別的設定或動到資產的交易會得到 MISMATCH。

text.en: Moves no asset, but gives a new person a key to this Safe: confirm the address with them and choose the threshold on purpose.
text.zh-TW: 不動任何資產，但會讓新的人拿到這個 Safe 的鑰匙：跟對方本人確認地址，門檻要想清楚再填。

text.en: verify checks that the new signer is exactly the address your address book holds under the name you pick, not that this address belongs to the person you mean. A look-alike address saved in the book would pass.
text.zh-TW: verify 檢查的是新簽署人正好是你地址簿裡那個名字的地址，不是這個地址真的屬於你想加的人。地址簿裡存了長得像的假地址也會通過。

recommendation.en: Before you save the address in your book, confirm the full address with the new signer through a second channel, such as a call, character by character.
recommendation.zh-TW: 存進地址簿之前，透過第二個管道（例如電話）跟新簽署人逐字確認完整地址。

text.en: Adding a signer without raising the threshold lowers the share of signers needed: 2 of 3 becomes 2 of 4. The Safe app keeps the current threshold by default, so this happens unless you type a higher one.
text.zh-TW: 加人但不提高門檻，需要簽名的比例就變低：3 取 2 變成 4 取 2。Safe 的 app 預設維持目前門檻，所以除非你填更高的數字，就會這樣。

recommendation.en: Choose the threshold for the new signer count on purpose; the card asks for it and verify holds the Safe to it.
recommendation.zh-TW: 依新的人數刻意選門檻；卡片會問，verify 會要求 Safe 最後就是這個數字。

text.en: The simulation marks `addOwnerWithThreshold` as moving no asset of the Safe. What it changes is control: the new address can sign, and with enough signatures move every asset the Safe holds.
text.zh-TW: 模擬標示 `addOwnerWithThreshold` 不動 Safe 的任何資產。它改的是控制權：新地址可以簽署，湊滿簽名就能動 Safe 裡的所有資產。

recommendation.en: Treat this like handing over a key: add only an address whose holder you know and who keeps the key on a hardware wallet.
recommendation.zh-TW: 把這當成交出一把鑰匙：只加你認識、且用硬體錢包保管鑰匙的人的地址。

1.addOwnerWithThreshold.owner.en: The new signer, taken from your address book. The Safe refuses the zero address, the list marker 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001, the Safe itself (GS203) and a current signer (GS204). From then on this key signs like every other.
1.addOwnerWithThreshold.owner.zh-TW: 新的簽署人，取自你的地址簿。Safe 拒絕零地址、名單標記 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001、Safe 自己（GS203）和現有簽署人（GS204）。之後這把鑰匙和其他人一樣能簽。

1.addOwnerWithThreshold._threshold.en: How many signatures every later transaction needs, counted over all signers including the new one. It must be from 1 to the new number of signers (GS201, GS202). The Safe app fills in the current threshold unless you change it.
1.addOwnerWithThreshold._threshold.zh-TW: 之後每筆交易需要幾個簽名，以加入新人後的全部簽署人計算。必須介於 1 到新的人數之間（GS201、GS202）。Safe 的 app 預設填目前的門檻，除非你改。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Every misfit batches `addOwnerWithThreshold` with more owner changes in one transaction: more additions, `swapOwner` or `removeOwner`. A card holds one owner change, so verify refuses such a batch; send each change as its own transaction.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 不合的都在一筆交易裡把 `addOwnerWithThreshold` 和其他 owner 變更綁在一起：再加人、`swapOwner` 或 `removeOwner`。一張卡片只放一項 owner 變更，verify 會拒絕這種批次，每項變更要各自一筆交易。
